description.p: CompositorLX is the native Qt Linux edition of Compositor. It edits layered images with masks, selections, adjustments, painting, transforms, filters, and non-destructive project storage.

Sync with Compositor 1.5.6. The GIF timeline has a large play button, a delay menu (Original or presets from 20 ms to 1 s) and numbered thumbnails whose right-click menu duplicates or deletes a frame. The Layers panel has a search field and a filter menu where several kinds of layer, or the selected layers, can be shown together. Canvas Size and Image Size keep the zoom and recenter the canvas.

Editable GIF layers, PDF import, RGB Split, channel packing, filter layers, pen pressure, styled lines, search, and PSD artboards. Refreshed with shared Vulkan rendering: accelerated filters and compositing that match the CPU, exports identical on every machine, compact GPU memory and tiling for large documents, an incremental canvas, asynchronous filter and Camera RAW previews, and a reworked Rendering panel.
